method: Enumerate every canonical S4 predecessor of a current exact S5 cache row; retain an S4 only if all independently regenerated legal S5 children are exact LOSS. Each retained four-stone set supplies both possible third/fourth move orders for each of its six two-stone subsets.
ranking_limit: S4 coverage and cache hit counts are finite-boundary metrics, not solver node/runtime guarantees.
scope_limit: This reverse index covers cache-derived S4 LOSS only. Terminal S4 positions with no legal fifth move are outside the predecessor index; no candidate is promoted without full pair-boundary validation.
